$Comment: Fridjitzu combo, hits 1 and 2: physical damage of the ice nunchucks (format of AT_Ice_King_Scepter_Hit_Damage). The CAE can change it with the Fridjitzu_Hit_Damage var. Fridjitzu combo hits 1 and 2 (the CAE override takes this file as Parent). 2026-10-21 (playtest: every hit of the king applies frost): half a frost stack through AT_Ice_King_Frost_Half_Hit (every second such hit adds one stack), since this hit is quick and frequent. Next is inherited by the Parent overrides. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Ice_Hit when the hit lands (was SFX_Ice_Break). 2026-10-22 block stamina (playtest: blocking the king with a plain sword barely cost stamina, 50 hits in a row): a blocked hit costs InitialAmount / StaminaCost.Value stamina (DamageSystems.DamageStamina; vanilla sword and shield Value 10 = 1 stamina per 10 damage, player stamina max 10, no regen while guarding, below 0 the guard breaks), times DamageEffects.StaminaDrainMultiplier (official field, inherited by Parent overrides; vanilla Gobliterator uppercut 10). StaminaDrainMultiplier 2.5: a blocked hit costs 2.5 x its damage / 10 (about 2.5 stamina for 10 damage; the CAE's 22-damage override about 5.5).
